text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back home from an outing, Silence Suzuka suddenly stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, it's just…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow her line of sight to find an arcade.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just inside sits a claw machine filled with an assortment of snow globes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking how pretty those are.
choice_data_list: Do you want to go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If it's okay with you…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then I'd love to. Just a quick little detour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We head inside and make our way directly to the claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… I'm supposed to press this button to move the claw, right?
choice_data_list: Are you sure you've got this?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm fine. You don't have to worry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or so she says.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Don't do that! Why's it going there?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The claw arm slowly extends downward and scoops up a great big bunch of nothing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Um…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Can I go get some more coins? I want to try just a few more times…
choice_data_list: You must really want one of those, huh?
You must really want one of those, huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …Yes. A miniature field of sparkling white snow…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I can imagine how pretty it would look sitting in my room…
choice_data_list: Mind if I give it a go?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I can imagine how pretty it would look sitting in my room…
choice_data_list: Mind if I give it a go?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you. That globe will be mine…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, right… Um…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Could you give me some advice? Like you do before a race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka seems determined to get a snow globe, so I give her some tips.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay… So, first… carefully, over the top…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then watch from the side as—oh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It fell… Okay, one more time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And another, and another, and another. She keeps trying until, finally…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The claw carries a snow globe to the collection tray and drops it in!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I did!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: This beautiful snowy landscape is mine to view whenever I want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka looks very pleased with herself as she carries her new snow globe home.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Could it be that you want one too?
choice_data_list: If I manage to get one, you can have it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Really? Oh, please try then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I trade spots with Silence Suzuka and take the controls.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Careful… Careful…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh! You grabbed one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-thump!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-you did it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… Can I really have it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Because if you were to change your mind later, I'm not sure I'd be able to let it go…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: For me…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now, I wonder where I should put it in my room…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: When I've decided, you'll be the first to know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka seems to be in a good mood as she carries her new snow globe home.
